warnings: External candidate and party incumbency fields are a provisional roster, not an election-certified source. Any candidate-ID/name mismatch or seat-holder mismatch fails closed for that candidate's incumbency.
An incumbent in a different office is NOT a same-office incumbent; appointment, freshman status and district overlap are unknown.
Do not use cash totals or small-dollar categories as Silver's individual in-state fundraising feature.
Tim Walz did not seek re-election and should not be assigned as MN-GOV candidate; approval measured for Walz cannot be copied as Amy Klobuchar approval.
Flanagan's lieutenant-governor role is distinct from incumbency for a U.S. Senate seat and does not establish an electoral penalty.
Approval transfer coefficients remain null until independently estimated.
External roster contradictions and independent seat holders are flagged as unresolved; do not classify them as verified open seats.

executive_approval_context.interpretation: Outgoing governor approval is not a ballot candidate's personal approval. No statewide partisan penalty implied.
